description: This file implements a Device Authentication token storage system for an Android application. It defines data classes for device auth entries, handles serialization/deserialization, and provides an interface and class for saving, loading, and clearing device tokens and metadata, using persistent preferences.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a device authentication token, role, scopes, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: PersistedDeviceAuthMetadata
classes.description: Serializable data class for storing metadata about device auth, such as scopes and timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for loading, saving, and clearing device auth tokens.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: Implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore using SecurePrefs to persist tokens and metadata.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a DeviceAuthEntry for a given device ID and role.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves a token with associated device ID, role, and scopes, updating metadata.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes the token and its metadata for a specified device ID and role.

methods.name: tokenKey
methods.description: Constructs a key string for token storage.

methods.name: metadataKey
methods.description: Constructs a key string for metadata storage.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Standardizes device IDs by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Standardizes roles by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Standardizes a list of scope strings.
